title: Rewrite signUp screen using design system
description: Rewrite signup_screen.dart using new design system primitives. Replace raw Material widgets with AppTextField (for name, email, password fields), AppButton (for register button), AppCard (for form container), and AppSnackbar for feedback. Preserve all behavior including bloc provider pattern, form validation,brasil_fields TelefoneInputFormatter on phone field, and navigation.
acceptance_criteria: Uses AppTextField for 3 form fields (name, email, password)
Phone field uses TextFormField with FilteringTextInputFormatter and TelefoneInputFormatter
Uses AppButton for register button with isLoading and isDisabled states
Uses AppSnackbar.error and AppSnackbar.success for feedback
BlocListener handles AuthFailure, AuthAuthenticated, AuthSuccess states
All colors/spacings via design tokens (AppColors, Spacing, AppTypography)
Double quotes used throughout, no emojis
completion_summary: Rewrote signup_screen.dart using AppTextField, AppButton, AppCard, and AppSnackbar design system primitives. Preserved all behavior including form validation, brasil_fields phone formatting, and bloc state handling. flutter analyze passes.
